title: Viva Engage: collapse and resize the left navigation, and reorder a larger favourites list
summary: The briefing accurately reports the navigation changes and the conflicting favourites limits. However, it says no spend cap or budget control applies without Microsoft documentation establishing that; the absence of a documented meter does not establish that budget controls do not apply.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published licensing terms specific to these new navigation controls, so their licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage left navigation collapse resize licensing license billing meter favorites. Opened Viva Engage setup requirements; read Core licensing and premium plans, neither of which identifies licensing specific to these controls. Roadmap and MC1470424 also name none.
